customer_description: Unit won't start at all. No lights on the control panel.
technician_notes: No power to panel. Main contactor coil open. Swapped contactor, unit runs.

customer_description: Maschine startet nicht, keine Anzeige am Display.
technician_notes: Kein Strom am Bedienfeld. Hauptschuetz defekt.

customer_description: no crank, dead panel
technician_notes: Ground strap at frame was loose, heavy corrosion. Cleaned and retorqued. Contactor tested OK.
resolution_text: Loose ground strap, retorqued and treated corrosion.

customer_description: Oil leak from boom cylinder, approx 1 drop per minute.
technician_notes: Rod seal weeping. Fitted seal kit, pressure tested, no further weep.

customer_description: Customer reported puddle of oil under the machine.
technician_notes: No oil leak found. Fluid was condensate from the chiller drain pan, drain line was blocked. Cleared line.
resolution_text: No leak. Blocked condensate drain line, cleared.

customer_description: Fuite hydraulique importante au niveau du verin de fleche, flaque sous la machine.
technician_notes: Verin raye, fuite continue sous charge. Remplacement complet du verin.

customer_description: hyd. lk @ boom cyl, ~1 drp/min
technician_notes: temp fix w/ sealant, ordered seal kit, cust to rebook

customer_description: Overheating after 20 minutes of running, high pressure alarm on the panel showing E-207, and an unusual rattling noise from the compressor head.
technician_notes: Valve plate worn, reed cracked. Discharge temp 118C at fault. Replaced valve plate assembly, temps normal after 40 min run.

customer_description: Machine overheats under load. No error codes displayed on the panel.
technician_notes: Cooling fan running but airflow low, intake screen packed with dust. Cleaned screen and fins. Temps back to normal.
resolution_text: Blocked intake screen restricting airflow, cleaned.

customer_description: Battery dead again, third time this month.
technician_notes: Alternator output 12.1V at 1500rpm, not charging. Battery itself tested serviceable. Replaced alternator.

customer_description: Unit dead on arrival at site, will not power up.
technician_notes: Battery flat, 8.4V. Charged and load tested, battery failed test. Replaced battery, charging system OK.

customer_description: Customer disputes the invoice for the last visit and requests a callback from the account manager.
technician_notes: Not a technical issue.

customer_description: Rattling noise from compressor head at high load.
technician_notes: Unit within warranty, swapped out complete unit per policy, did not strip down.
resolution_text: Replaced unit under warranty, works now.

customer_description: Il compressore si surriscalda dopo circa 20 minuti e fa un rumore metallico. Sul display appare E207.
technician_notes: Piastra valvole usurata. Sostituita, temperature nella norma.

customer_description: Machine won't start, happens most mornings when it is cold.
technician_notes: Unit started first attempt on arrival, ran 30 min without fault. No codes stored. Advised customer to log time and ambient temp if it recurs.

customer_description: Chiller short cycling, compressor cuts out after 2-3 minutes. Panel shows LP-01.
technician_notes: Low refrigerant charge. Leak traced to schrader valve on suction line. Replaced valve, evacuated and recharged.
resolution_text: Low refrigerant charge, leak at schrader valve.

customer_description: Loud knocking noise from cylinder 1 when running under load.
technician_notes: Play at crank end, cyl 1 conrod bearing worn. Replaced bearing set, noise gone after test run.
resolution_text: Worn connecting rod bearing on cylinder 1 replaced.

customer_description: Knocking noise from cylinder 2. Display flashed err 207 once but cleared.
technician_notes: Broken reed valve fragment sitting in cyl 2, piston crown lightly scored. Removed debris, replaced valve, ran 30 min clean.
resolution_text: Broken valve fragment in cylinder 2 removed, valve replaced.

customer_description: Klopfgeraeusch im Zylinder, wird unter Last lauter.
technician_notes: Pleuellager Zylinder 1 verschlissen, Spiel fuehlbar. Lager ersetzt.

customer_description: Water spraying from the hot side of the unit, looks like it is under pressure.
technician_notes: Condenser pump mechanical seal failed. Replaced seal, pressure tested loop, dry.

customer_description: Slow water drip on the cold water side of the machine.
technician_notes: Corroded compression fitting on chilled water return line. Replaced fitting, no further drip.
resolution_text: Corroded fitting on chilled water return replaced.

customer_description: Water leaking from the machine.
technician_notes: Traced to condenser pump seal, weeping under pressure. Replaced seal.
